notify.causes: What it can cause is one thing: refresh these keys of this forest's own recorded source. It cannot adopt, cannot change the destination, cannot name another source and cannot reach another forest.
notify.create_hint: The secret is shown once, in the answer that creates it, and can never be read back.
notify.label: Label
notify.label_hint: For you, to tell two of them apart.
notify.list_sub: Each one is a secret somebody holds, for as long as it exists. Removing it is how it stops.
notify.needs_admin: A subscription is a governance object: it needs the admin capability on this forest.
notify.remove_hint: A removed subscription refuses exactly like a wrong signature: the caller is never told which of the two it was.
notify.secret_id: Send it with the subscription id
notify.secret_once: Shown once. Closing this is the end of it — a lost secret is replaced by creating another subscription and removing this one.
notify.secret_sub: Copy it now: it is stored nowhere it can be read from.
notify.secret_use: Keep it where the caller runs — an environment variable, a secret manager. This console cannot show it again.
notify.sign_headers: Three headers: the subscription id, the timestamp, and an HMAC-SHA256 over <timestamp>.<body> as sha256=<hex>.
notify.sign_refusal: Every failure answers the same refusal — a missing signature, a wrong one, a stale timestamp and an unknown subscription are one reply, because a different answer per cause would tell an unauthenticated caller which half they got right.
notify.sign_skew: A timestamp more than {n} minutes from the Station's clock is refused. It is inside the signed string, so a captured body cannot be replayed forever.
notify.sign_sub: One signing rule in this product: verified here, produced by every webhook that leaves.
notify.sub: A Lambda, an n8n flow or a queue consumer refreshes the keys it names. No person and no key — the signature is the whole authority.
notify.title: Tell this forest that something changed
notify.url_hint: POST a body of {keys: […]} here. A notification is an event, not a backfill — a backfill is Sync, and the Station bounds how many keys one call may carry.
notify.url_max: This deployment accepts at most {n} keys in one call.
